newsitem.title: USA: Chartwell Leisure retains investment banker.
newsitem.headline: Chartwell Leisure retains investment banker.

text.p: Chartwell Leisure Inc said on Monday it has hired Bear, Stearns & Co Inc. and Chase Securities Inc to help Chartwell consider strategic alternatives, including a possible sale of the company, considering the "robust" state of the lodging industry.
The board has not made a decision regarding any particular transaction, Chartwell said.

Richard Fisher, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement, "In light of the current robust state of the lodging market, we believe that it is appropriate to consider all options for our company."

Chartwell owns, directly or with joint venture partners, approximately 130 hotel properties in both the full-service and limited-service segments, containing approximately 11,400 guest rooms, located in 25 states and six Canadian provinces.
